name: A Tamed Beast whistle pet comes back after mount and dismount (#9186)
contract: Mounting temporarily unsummons the hunter pet (Unit::Mount) and dismounting reloads it as the current pet through
Pet::LoadPetFromDB, which refuses a current pet whose creating spell has a duration (a temporary summon).
The wardrobe's Tamed Beast whistle (ReplaceTamedBeast) recorded Tame Beast 1515, the 20-second channel
(SpellDuration 18), as the creating spell, so the whistle pet never came back after a dismount and the pet bar
stayed empty. A native tame records 13481, the spell carrying SPELL_EFFECT_TAMECREATURE, which has no duration.
Appearance 48864 is Forest Spider 30 (family 3, tameable): after mount and dismount it must return.

steps.label: The Forest Spider is the pet
Mounting puts the Forest Spider away
Dismounting brings the Forest Spider back
